title: Micah's Idolatry

questions.question: How much silver did Micah confess to taking from his mother?
questions.explanation: Judges 17:2 (ESV): "...The 1,100 pieces of silver that were taken from you... Behold, the silver is with me..."

questions.question: What did Micah's mother do with the silver when returned?
options: Dedicated it to the Lord to make a carved image and a metal image
questions.correctAnswer: Dedicated it to the Lord to make a carved image and a metal image
questions.explanation: Judges 17:3 (ESV): "...I dedicate the silver to the LORD... to make a carved image and a metal image."

questions.question: Who did Micah first install as priest?
questions.explanation: Judges 17:5 (ESV): "...and he ordained one of his sons, who became his priest."

questions.question: Who came to Micah's house from Bethlehem in Judah?
questions.explanation: Judges 17:7 (ESV): "Now there was a young man of Bethlehem in Judah... who was a Levite..."

questions.question: What phrase describes the state of Israel in those days?
options: In those days there was no king in Israel. Everyone did what was right in his own eyes.
questions.correctAnswer: In those days there was no king in Israel. Everyone did what was right in his own eyes.
questions.explanation: Judges 17:6 (ESV): "In those days there was no king in Israel. Everyone did what was right in his own eyes."

questions.question: Where was Micah from?
questions.explanation: Judges 17:1 (ESV): "There was a man of the hill country of Ephraim whose name was Micah."

questions.question: What deal did Micah offer the Levite?
options: 10 pieces of silver a year and a suit of clothes and your living
questions.correctAnswer: 10 pieces of silver a year and a suit of clothes and your living
questions.explanation: Judges 17:10 (ESV): "...and I will give you ten pieces of silver a year and a suit of clothes and your living."

questions.question: What religious objects did Micah have?
options: A shrine, an ephod, and household gods
questions.correctAnswer: A shrine, an ephod, and household gods
questions.explanation: Judges 17:5 (ESV): "And the man Micah had a shrine, and he made an ephod and household gods..."

questions.question: How did the Levite respond to Micah's offer?
options: He was content to dwell with the man
questions.correctAnswer: He was content to dwell with the man
questions.explanation: Judges 17:11 (ESV): "And the Levite was content to dwell with the man..."

questions.question: What did Micah conclude after hiring the Levite?
options: Now I know that the Lord will prosper me
questions.correctAnswer: Now I know that the Lord will prosper me
questions.explanation: Judges 17:13 (ESV): "Then Micah said, 'Now I know that the LORD will prosper me, because I have a Levite as priest.'"

questions.question: How much silver was actually given to the silversmith?
questions.explanation: Judges 17:4 (ESV): "...and his mother took 200 pieces of silver and gave them to the silversmith..."

questions.question: The Levite became to Micah like one of his ____?
questions.explanation: Judges 17:11 (ESV): "...and the young man became to him like one of his sons."

questions.question: What titles did Micah ask the Levite to hold?
questions.explanation: Judges 17:10 (ESV): "...Stay with me, and be to me a father and a priest..."

questions.question: The Levite was technically sojourning where before coming to Micah?
questions.explanation: Judges 17:7-8 (ESV): "...And the man departed from the town of Bethlehem in Judah to sojourn where he could find a place."

questions.question: Did the Levite belong to the tribe of Judah?
options: No, but he lived in the territory (Bethlehem in Judah)
questions.correctAnswer: No, but he lived in the territory (Bethlehem in Judah)
questions.explanation: Judges 17:7 (ESV): "...of the family of Judah, who was a Levite..." (Context implies geography/association, as Levites are a separate tribe).

key_verse_text: In those days there was no king in Israel. Everyone did what was right in his own eyes. (ESV)
